fullText: Jeffrey Epstein Born: January 20, 1953, Brooklyn, New York Died: August 10, 2019, Metropolitan Correctional Center, Manhattan (ruled suicide; contested) Category: Central figure Source files: All 9 source files Born January 20, 1953, Brooklyn, New York Died August 10, 2019, Metropolitan Correctional Center, Manhattan (ruled suicide; contested) Category Central figure Source files All 9 source files Background and early career Epstein attended Lafayette High School in Brooklyn and enrolled at Cooper Union and then New York University, though he did not complete a degree. In 1974 he was hired as a math teacher at the Dalton School in Manhattan, where he met investment banker Alan "Ace" Greenberg's son. This connection led to a position at Bear Stearns circa 1976, where he rose to limited partner by 1980. He left Bear Stearns under disputed circumstances in 1981 — officially for violating SEC regulations — and founded J. Epstein & Co., ostensibly a private financial advisory firm serving billionaires with a minimum client threshold of $1 billion in assets. His claimed expertise was tax and asset strategies for ultra-high-net-worth clients. Relationship with Wexner The foundational relationship of Epstein's wealth was with Limited Brands founder Leslie Wexner, who hired Epstein as his money manager in the mid-1980s. In 1991, Wexner granted Epstein a sweeping power of attorney giving him "full power and authority to do and perform every act necessary" over finances, investments, and property. Wexner transferred the 9 East 71st Street Manhattan townhouse (purchased for $13.2 million in 1989) to Epstein for $0, along with the Palm Beach estate. House Oversight Democrats stated the total transferred was approximately $1 billion; Wexner's attorneys told investigators Epstein had repaid $100 million — "thought to be just a portion of what he stole." Properties Epstein owned or controlled: the Manhattan townhouse at 9 East 71st Street (the largest private residence in Manhattan by some accounts); a Palm Beach mansion at 358 El Brillo Way; Little St. James Island (USVI, ~70 acres, "Lolita Express" destination); Zorro Ranch, New Mexico (~7,600–10,000 acres, purchased 1993 from Gov. Bruce King family for ~$12 million through shell company "Zorro Trust"); and a Paris apartment on Avenue Foch. He also controlled an apartment at 301 East 66th Street, Manhattan (technically owned by brother Mark Epstein), which staff referred to as "Ehud's apartment." [Multiple sources] Financial structure Epstein operated through an elaborate web of shell entities including Southern Trust Company Inc. (USVI, $391.3 million in assets by 2017, 13 employees, claimed to provide "biomedical and financial informatics" — actually a payment conduit), Financial Trust Company Inc., Plan D LLC (holding the Boeing 727 and Gulfstream G550), Hyperion Air LLC (helicopters), Gratitude America Ltd. (philanthropy front), The 1953 Trust (final estate vehicle, $577–600 million), Butterfly Trust, La Hougue, HBRK Associates, Coatue Enterprises, C.O.U.Q. Foundation, Enhanced Education, JEGE Inc./LLC, NES LLC, Georgarage LLC, and others. The trafficking operation The core criminal enterprise involved recruiting underage girls under the guise of massage therapy, sexually abusing them at his multiple properties, and sharing them with associates. Recruiters were paid $200 per girl they brought. Epstein told recruiter Haley Robson "the younger the better." The DOJ files documented a recruitment pyramid: Palm Beach Police identified 27 girls and women aged 14–23, FBI grand jury testimony confirmed "more than a majority would have been under the age of 18," and the 86-page SDNY co-conspirators memo (December 19, 2019) contained statements from 24 women abused as minors and 14 abused as adults. A 32-count draft indictment named 19 victims (Jane Does #1–#19), the youngest 14 years old. Emails and communications Epstein's emails (accessible via JMail at jmail.world, cataloging 1,038,603 emails from jeevacation@gmail.com and jeeproject@yahoo.com) reveal extensive communications with Bannon, Gates, Summers, Wolff, Clinton, Chomsky, and dozens of others. Key emails include: April 2, 2011 to Maxwell ("that dog that hasn't barked is trump"); January 31, 2019 to Wolff ("Of course he knew about the girls as he asked ghislaine to stop"); a December 2015 email to NYT reporter Landon Thomas Jr. offering "photos of donald and girls in bikinis in my kitchen"; a 2018 email about Trump: "I am the one able to take him down"; a 2017 email to Summers calling Trump "the most dangerous person I have ever met." Epstein also communicated detailed transhumanist ambitions: plans to impregnate 20 women simultaneously at Zorro Ranch; a 2018 designer-baby proposal to Bryan Bishop for $1.7M/year; a 2016 email to Joscha Bach about genetically modifying Black people. Austrian passport Dataset 8 released an expired Austrian passport under the alias "Marius Robert Fortelni" listing a Saudi Arabian address. Final days On August 8, 2019, Epstein signed the 1953 Trust will ($577.6 million estate), naming Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn as executors, with beneficiaries including $100M to Karyna Shuliak, $50M to Indyke, $25M to Kahn, $10M each to Maxwell and brother Mark Epstein, and $5M to Harvard professor Martin Nowak. On August 9, his cellmate Efrain Reyes was transferred out; that evening he made an unmonitored phone call (telling staff he was calling his "mother," who died in 2003 — actually calling girlfriend Karyna Shuliak). On August 10, 2019, he was found dead at approximately 6:30 AM, suspended from the top bunk by a makeshift noose. Official ruling: suicide by hanging. Contested by Dr. Michael Baden and Epstein's family. Intelligence connections EFTA00090314 contains an FBI Confidential Human Source report (unverified) claiming Epstein "was a co-opted Mossad agent trained as a spy" for Israel, and that Dershowitz told then-US Attorney Acosta that Epstein "belonged to both U.S. and allied intelligence services." A 2018 email about Robert Maxwell claims Maxwell threatened Mossad: "unless they gave him £400 million to save his crumbling empire, he would expose all he had done for them." Acosta reportedly told Trump transition vetting team he was told Epstein "belonged to intelligence" with a "leave-it-alone" status (denied by Acosta under oath). --- Personal Media Evidence (Dataset 10) Personal media files from Epstein's electronic devices released in EFTA Dataset 10. Contains videos from properties, private jets, and personal recordings. Some content flagged as sensitive or explicit. title: Ghislaine Maxwell
excerpt: Born: December 25, 1961, Maisons-Laffitte, France Category: Co-conspirator / operational director Current status: Convicted; serving 20 years at FCI Tallahassee Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Ghislaine Maxwell Born: December 25, 1961, Maisons-Laffitte, France Category: Co-conspirator / operational director Current status: Convicted; serving 20 years at FCI Tallahassee Source files: All 9 source files Born December 25, 1961, Maisons-Laffitte, France Category Co-conspirator / operational director Current status Convicted; serving 20 years at FCI Tallahassee Source files All 9 source files Maxwell, daughter of British media mogul Robert Maxwell (who died under suspicious circumstances in 1991), became Epstein's primary partner and alleged procurer. She was convicted on December 29, 2021, of five federal charges including sex trafficking of a minor, and sentenced to 20 years on June 28, 2022, by Judge Alison Nathan. Operational role Maxwell handled the day-to-day management of the trafficking operation, recruited victims, participated in abuse, and coordinated staff. Government Exhibit GX 606 (household manual) instructed staff to "see nothing, hear nothing, say nothing" and "NEVER disclose Mr. Epstein or Ms. Maxwell's activities." Flight records (GX 662) showed Maxwell and Sarah Kellen flew together approximately 39 times in 2003 alone. Maxwell appeared on approximately 400–520 documented flight legs — the most frequent flier after Epstein. Her initials ("GM") appear on each of Clinton's 26 flight legs. Key testimony In her April 22, 2016 videotaped deposition (Giuffre v. Maxwell), Maxwell denied most allegations. At her 2025 interview with DAG Todd Blanche, she stated Clinton was "my friend, not Epstein's friend." She confirmed her father Robert Maxwell "functioned as" an intelligence officer "throughout his life, passing on secrets to governments, including Israel." At her February 10, 2026 House Oversight deposition, she invoked the Fifth Amendment throughout; her attorney offered testimony exonerating both Trump and Clinton in exchange for clemency: "Both President Trump and President Clinton are innocent of any wrongdoing. Ms. Maxwell alone can explain why." Topless photos Juan Alessi's deposition (Giuffre v. Maxwell, Dkt. 1158) described Maxwell taking topless photos of young women. Maxwell denied providing Giuffre "an outfit of a sexual nature to wear for Les Wexner." An October 2005 email shows Maxwell told Epstein she met a CIA operative who "worked" with her father and could "find all, and reveal all (for a price)." Melania email October 23, 2002: Melania Trump emailed Maxwell: "Dear G! How are you? Nice story about JE in NY mag. You look great in the picture… Give me a call when you are back in NY." Maxwell replied warmly, calling her "Sweet pea." Three wiretap discs The Maxwell grand jury transcripts were ordered released December 9, 2025. Three discs containing wiretap results from Maxwell's phone number have not been publicly released. Finances Dataset 11 includes Maxwell's UBS account wiring instructions. A June 15, 2007 wire transfer showed $7.4 million moved from Epstein's BNY account to Maxwell's JPMorgan account; Maxwell moved it the same day to "Air Ghislaine, Inc."; three days later $7.3 million went to Sikorsky Aircraft for a helicopter. EFTA01296151 contains a trust agreement naming Maxwell as beneficiary. --- Interrogation Videos (EFTA) Video recordings of Maxwell's interrogation/deposition released via EFTA Datasets 9 and 10. title: Lesley Groff
excerpt: Category: Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status: Not charged Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Lesley Groff Category: Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status: Not charged Source files: All 9 source files Category Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status Not charged EFTA Document Frequency & Legal Status Lesley Groff was Epstein's primary executive assistant for 20 years, appearing 157,613 times in EFTA documents — more than any other individual. Named as a co-conspirator in the 2008 Non-Prosecution Agreement, she received blanket immunity from federal sex trafficking charges. FBI emails state she was "in charge of making phone calls to set up massage appointments" — Epstein's code for sexual encounters with victims. The Southern District of New York investigation concluded in December 2021 without charging her. In the "whoops" email context, Groff handled the June 8, 2015 scheduling around Jay Thomas's anniversary show at SiriusXM (EFTA00347727). Jay Thomas (1948–2017) was an Emmy-winning actor and beloved SiriusXM radio host who died August 24, 2017, of throat cancer. Source files All 9 source files Groff has 157,613 mentions in DOJ files — the second most-mentioned person in the entire release after Epstein himself. As Epstein's executive assistant in Connecticut, she handled scheduling, travel arrangements, and communications. Her February 2020 attorney proffer described her scheduling massage appointments as "just part of his normal day. Akin to someone going daily to the gym." Three days of scheduling emails (December 1–3, 2010) show Groff coordinating meetings simultaneously with Jes Staley, Bill Gates, and Leon Black. An August 2019 FBI email identifies a Connecticut-resident co-conspirator "deciding whether to cooperate" — matching Groff's biographical details. A November 5, 2020 "DAG Meeting Overview" email indicates the DOJ was in plea negotiations with a possible co-conspirator during Trump's first term, with "Anticipated Charges" fully redacted. Groff was granted immunity under the NPA. ---

title: Nadia Marcinkova
excerpt: Category: Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status: FAA-certified commercial pilot; reportedly missing since early January 2024 Source files: Multiple
fullText: Nadia Marcinkova Category: Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status: FAA-certified commercial pilot; reportedly missing since early January 2024 Source files: Multiple Category Co-conspirator (immunity grantee) Current status FAA-certified commercial pilot; reportedly missing since early January 2024 "Whoops" Email & Disappearance (2024) Almost certainly the "Nadia" whoops email recipient (EFTA01987274). Born 1986 in Košice, Slovakia. Epstein allegedly bragged about having "purchased" her from her family and referred to her as his "Yugoslavian sex slave." Brought to the US around age 13–15. Victims testified she encouraged and participated in sexual acts with underage girls at Epstein's direction. She visited Epstein 67–70 times during his 2008–2009 incarceration. She pleaded the Fifth Amendment 42 times in a 2010 civil deposition, including when asked about Prince Andrew and Bill Clinton. Named as a co-conspirator in the 2008 Non-Prosecution Agreement, she received blanket federal immunity. She later obtained a pilot's license, founded the aviation company Aviloop with Epstein's financial backing, and branded herself "Global Girl" after Gulfstream sued over trademark infringement. She has been missing since early January 2024, disappearing when the first major Epstein court documents were unsealed. Source files Multiple Palm Beach police reports state Epstein told one victim he had "purchased" Marcinkova at age 15 from her family in Yugoslavia to be his "sex slave." She "encouraged and engaged in sexual acts" with young girls while Epstein watched. She invoked the Fifth Amendment repeatedly, including when asked questions about Alan Dershowitz. She appears on approximately 110 documented flight legs. EFTA01297516 contains a trust agreement naming both Brunel and Maxwell as beneficiaries — Marcinkova's status in trust documents was separately documented. Granted immunity under the NPA. ---

title: Darren Indyke
excerpt: Category: Attorney / executor / financial facilitator Source files: Multiple
fullText: Darren Indyke Category: Attorney / executor / financial facilitator Source files: Multiple Category Attorney / executor / financial facilitator Source files Multiple Epstein's primary attorney and estate executor. Named as co-executor of the 1953 Trust along with Richard Kahn. Companies SLK Designs LLC and Hyperion Air, both controlled by Indyke, were named in the DEA's previously undisclosed investigation ("Operation Chain Reaction") for approximately $50 million in suspicious wire transfers. Indyke made 97 cash withdrawals of exactly $7,500 each from Deutsche Bank accounts — textbook structuring to avoid Currency Transaction Reports — occurring 2–3 times monthly from 2013 to 2017. In one documented instance, he asked about the $10,000 reporting threshold and, upon learning it would trigger a report, split the withdrawal over two days. The 1953 Trust left Indyke $50 million. Named in DOJ staff phone sheet alongside Groff, Visoski, Kahn, Klein, and Brunel (EFTA00282489). Forensic finance analysis shows Indyke processed $320.1M through Epstein's shell entity network. Bank Leumi Wire Authorization Indyke authorized a $1,000,000 wire from Southern Trust account 9244 to Bank Leumi LeIsrael, Branch 771, for "Reporty Investment" (Carbyne/Barak's surveillance company) on March 16, 2015 (EFTA01404004, EFTA01360536, EFTA01360528 — three copies of the wire memorandum). When Tomer Toor requested the controlling person's identity for Southern Trust, Indyke responded: "I thought we did not want your name associated with this Investment." Indyke also drafted Nili Priell Barak's consulting agreement through Taurus Ltd in March 2008, and his email signature already contained the Bank Leumi Pinkas branch address — indicating an established Israeli banking relationship. title: Richard Kahn
excerpt: Category: Accountant / executor Source files: Multiple
fullText: Richard Kahn Category: Accountant / executor Source files: Multiple Category Accountant / executor "Whoops" Research: Co-Executor & Co-Conspirator Kahn was Epstein's in-house accountant since 2005 and co-executor of Epstein's estate, named in the will signed two days before Epstein's death. He appeared 52,781 times in EFTA documents. The FBI listed him as one of 10 co-conspirators in 2019. A class action accused him of structuring bank accounts for cash access and participating in sham marriages for immigration fraud; Kahn and co-executor Darren Indyke settled for $35 million. Epstein planned to leave Kahn $25 million from the 1953 Trust. Between 2001 and 2019, Epstein entities paid Kahn over $10 million. Received a "whoops" email on July 4, 2016 (EFTA02457915). Notable events in the surrounding window: the Istanbul Atatürk airport attack (June 28, 45 killed) and Nobel laureate Elie Wiesel's death (July 2). Source files Multiple Kahn has 52,781 mentions in the DOJ files — the third most-mentioned person in the release. Named as co-executor of the 1953 Trust with Indyke. He received $25 million under the will. EFTA01282292 contains his attorney/trustee records. Named on Epstein's staff phone sheet. HBRK Wire to Israel On March 16, 2017, Kahn's firm HBRK Associates wired $40,000 to Achrayut Leumit (Ehud Barak's political entity) at Bank Leumi Le Israel, Branch 666, Ramat Gan. When Deutsche Bank compliance investigator Danya Friedman flagged the wire (Case 141374), Kahn's answers came through his assistant Cynthia Rodriguez: Purpose: "Contributions for public policy organization in Israel"; Relationship: "Friend"; Business activities: "Public Policy Org." No escalation followed. Additionally, 126 CDs and DVDs were seized from suitcases belonging to Kahn; their contents have never been publicly disclosed. fullText: Alfredo Rodriguez Category: House manager (Palm Beach) / FBI informant Source files: Multiple Category House manager (Palm Beach) / FBI informant Source files Multiple Rodriguez secretly copied Epstein's black book — which he called the "Holy Grail" — and attempted to sell it for $50,000 to an undercover FBI agent. title: Ted Waitt
excerpt: Aliases: Batman Category: Tech billionaire / Maxwell romantic partner / network financial benefactor Source files: DOJ EFTA Datasets 9, 11
fullText: Ted Waitt Aliases: Batman Category: Tech billionaire / Maxwell romantic partner / network financial benefactor Source files: DOJ EFTA Datasets 9, 11 Aliases Batman Category Tech billionaire / Maxwell romantic partner / network financial benefactor Source files DOJ EFTA Datasets 9, 11 Theodore "Ted" Waitt, founder of Gateway Inc. (personal computers) and philanthropist. Confirmed as "Batman" via October 12, 2004 Epstein email in which Epstein explicitly refers to "Tom/Ted Waitt" as "batman" (EFTA02333073). Long-term romantic partner of Ghislaine Maxwell (2003–2010 per Maxwell legal filings), during the most active period of the Epstein trafficking operation. Maxwell's attorneys described Waitt as a "committed partner" with whom she began a "seven-year romantic relationship" in 2003 and "developed a strong and loving bond with his four children, ranging in age from six to twelve." Maxwell attended Chelsea Clinton's 2010 wedding as Waitt's guest and helped him obtain and renovate the luxury yacht Plan B. Financial Pipeline A July 31, 2016 email establishes Waitt in the role of financial provider to a young woman in Epstein's orbit: Epstein receives email in which the sender describes telling him "how much Batman gave me per month." Epstein responds that Batman "wants to keep you short so that you can never be independent" (EFTA00822913). This framing — a wealthy man providing monthly payments to a young woman while Epstein manages the relationship and counsels against financial independence — is consistent with the documented Epstein pattern of creating financial dependency. An undated email references "going to batman's house in Paris tomorrow" from a redacted sender (EFTA01067377). Network Significance A young woman in Epstein's network (probable identity: Mélusine Ruspoli) identified "batman" as someone to whom she could have disclosed "the truth about you [Epstein]" — indicating Waitt had proximity to information about Epstein's conduct and was considered a potential source of leverage against Epstein. --- EFTA Document Evidence — Batman References EFTA documents where Epstein refers to Ted Waitt as "Batman." Includes financial control dynamics and Paris house reference.

title: Alexander Acosta (Alex Acosta)
excerpt: Born: January 16, 1969 Category: Former U.S. Attorney / political figure Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Alexander Acosta (Alex Acosta) Born: January 16, 1969 Category: Former U.S. Attorney / political figure Source files: All 9 source files Born January 16, 1969 Category Former U.S. Attorney / political figure Source files All 9 source files As U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Florida, Acosta negotiated and signed the Non-Prosecution Agreement (NPA) on September 24, 2007 — one day before AUSA Marie Villafaña was prepared to file the indictment. The NPA granted immunity to Epstein plus four named co-conspirators plus "any potential co-conspirators." The original 53-page draft federal indictment with 60 criminal counts prepared by Villafaña in May 2007 was never filed. Acosta served as Trump's Labor Secretary from April 2017 until July 2019, when he resigned amid renewed scrutiny of the plea deal following Epstein's arrest. In a September 19, 2025 closed-door interview with the House Oversight Committee (transcript released October 17, 2025), Acosta said a DOJ Child Exploitation section attorney called going to trial a "crapshoot" due to evidentiary issues. He denied ever meeting Epstein or Maxwell and denied seeing Trump's name on any Epstein-related document. He denied under oath the quote attributed to him (by journalist Vicky Ward) that he was told Epstein "belonged to intelligence" and was given a "leave-it-alone" directive. The DOJ Office of Professional Responsibility report found his handling was "poor judgment" but not "professional misconduct." [Multiple sources] ---

title: William Barr
excerpt: Category: Attorney General (Trump's first term) Source files: Multiple

title: Leon Black
excerpt: Category: Apollo Global Management founder Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Leon Black Category: Apollo Global Management founder Source files: All 9 source files Category Apollo Global Management founder Source files All 9 source files Leon Black paid Jeffrey Epstein between $158 million (per the 2021 Dechert investigation) and $170 million (per the Senate Finance Committee's 2025 review of Treasury records) from late 2012 through April 2017. The Black-Epstein financial relationship is the most extensively documented in terms of raw dollar volume. Epstein referred to Black as "Mr. Big" in emails. Payment Architecture Payments flowed from at least seven Black-controlled entities — including Black Family Partners, Narrows Holdings, Elysium Management, and BV70 LLC — to Epstein entities Southern Trust Company, Financial Trust Company, Plan D LLC, and Gratitude America Ltd., primarily through Deutsche Bank accounts. The stated justification was tax advisory services: Epstein purportedly identified and fixed a defect in Black's 2006 Grantor Retained Annuity Trust (GRAT) that could have triggered $500 million to $1 billion in estate tax liability, and later executed a "step-up basis" transaction saving an estimated $600 million. However, Black's own attorneys later told the Senate Finance Committee that Epstein's ideas were "in the public domain and originated with Black's other legal advisors" — raising the question of why a man without a college degree, CPA license, or law license was paid $170 million for advice available from existing counsel. Black also made $22.5 million and $8 million loans to Epstein in early 2017 via BV70 LLC to Plan D LLC; Epstein repaid only $10 million before death. Approximately $100 million of the payments (2014–2017) were made without any written contract. The Dechert investigation missed $12 million in payments that federal records later revealed. Apollo Fund Timing Correlation The payment timeline maps with remarkable precision onto Apollo Global Management's most consequential fundraising period. The first known payment (~$5.5 million, November 2012) arrived as Apollo was closing its acquisition of McGraw-Hill Education for $2.5 billion. The first formal payment under a signed service agreement ($15 million, February 15, 2013) preceded Apollo Fund VIII's final close at $18.4 billion — the largest private equity fund since the financial crisis — by ten months. Peak payments occurred in 2014 ($70 million), the year Apollo acquired Chuck E. Cheese's (~$1 billion) and merged Endemol with Shine Group. 2016 saw zero payments as the relationship deteriorated over a payment dispute. 2017's final $8 million payment plus $30.5 million in loans coincided with Apollo Fund IX raising $24.6 billion, the largest buyout fund in history at that time. The Dechert report found "Apollo never retained Epstein for any services" and "Epstein never invested in any Apollo-managed fund" — with one exception: Financial Trust Company purchased 263,257 shares in Apollo's March 2011 IPO. USVI Immunity Deal Black paid $62.5 million to the U.S. Virgin Islands in January 2023 for criminal immunity — immunity that explicitly covered himself, his attorneys, agents, and private entities. The settlement acknowledged that "Jeffrey Epstein used the money Black paid him to partially fund his operations in the Virgin Islands." Bank of America waited up to seven years before filing its first SAR. Neither the GRATs nor the trust structures were ever audited by the IRS. Bank of America trial set for May 11, 2026. Forensic Finance Verification (February 2026) $310.5M verified across 42 wire transfers from five Black-controlled entities (Black Family Partners LP, BV70 LLC, Narrow Holdings LLC, Elysium Management), backed by specific Bates-stamped bank documents (DB-SDNY-0002962 through DB-SDNY-0006113 and EFTA01075607). Single October 2008 wire from Epstein to Black Family Partners LP transferred $50M (EFTA01075607). Identified as "Human Trafficking Subject" in SDNY emails from June 2023 (EFTA02731636, EFTA00156644). Allegations and Coordinated Payments The DOJ files include an October 16, 2018 message directly accusing Black of sexual harassment, trafficking, and rape. A Jane Doe federal lawsuit alleges Black raped her in 2002 at age 16 at Epstein's Manhattan residence. Epstein coordinated $600,000+ in "gifts" to a former Eastern European model on Black's behalf. Gratitude America's philanthropy front received most of its funding from a $10 million grant controlled by Black. JPMorgan's SAR covered transactions by Black, Dubin, Dershowitz, and Wexner totaling approximately $1 billion. --- Forensic Financial Analysis (Wire Ledger) Inflows (Unverified): $119,720,939 across 13 wires from 5 source(s). title: Glenn Dubin
excerpt: Category: Hedge fund manager (Highbridge Capital) Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Glenn Dubin Category: Hedge fund manager (Highbridge Capital) Source files: All 9 source files Category Hedge fund manager (Highbridge Capital) Source files All 9 source files Prosecution planning document EFTA00098755 formally lists Dubin under "Individuals Who Have Engaged in Massages with Epstein Girls." FBI "Prominent Names" briefing page (EFTA01660622, p. 17) shows a "direct victim allegation of sexual abuse facilitated by Ghislaine Maxwell." Virginia Giuffre testified in 2016: "Ghislaine told me to go to Glenn Dubin and give him a massage, which means sex." Former Dubin household manager Rinaldo Rizzo testified about encountering a 15-year-old girl allegedly trafficked by Epstein at the Dubins' home in 2005. Flight logs document 34+ shared flights and 18+ Dubin family flights on Epstein's planes (1996–2005). Eva Dubin's (now Eva Andersson Dubin's) number appears on Epstein's staff phone sheet (EFTA00282489) alongside Groff, Indyke, Visoski, Kahn, Klein, and Brunel. A CEHTTF subpoena (EFTA00154007) from the NYPD/FBI Child Exploitation Human Trafficking Task Force requested Eva Dubin's personal information. JPMorgan-Highbridge Nexus Epstein's approximately 1998 introduction of JPMorgan executive Jes Staley to Glenn Dubin led to JPMorgan's 2004 acquisition of a 55% stake in Highbridge Capital for $1.3 billion. Epstein received an estimated $15–20 million for brokering this deal and invested $10 million in Highbridge through a Virgin Islands entity. By 2003, USVI court filings describe Epstein as "by double, the top revenue generator in JPMorgan's Private Bank," bringing in clients including Dubin, Sergey Brin, and others. JPMorgan completed its full acquisition of Highbridge in July 2009 — shortly after Epstein's release from his Florida sentence. Eva's Ongoing Financial Facilitation Eva Andersson-Dubin was actively facilitating Epstein's hedge fund connections as late as February 2016, eight years post-conviction. DOJ files show David Fiszel (Honeycomb Asset Management) emailing Epstein: "Eva Dubin gave me your email address." Epstein became a "day-one investor and co-investment partner" in Honeycomb, which grew to approximately $1.5 billion AUM. Epstein's financial entanglement with the family took an extraordinary form in Thanksgiving 2017, when files document he spent the holiday with "eva." Celina Dubin Trust In 2014, Epstein named Celina Dubin as beneficiary of a ~$50 million trust. In January 2019, a revised trust made her the largest beneficiary, inheriting Zorro Ranch, the USVI estate, and the residual balance. Eva was named backup trustee. The Dubins say they were unaware until 2020. USVI subpoenas to the Dubins specifically sought records of "three wire transfers between 2014 and 2016" between the Dubins and Epstein entities — the nature and amounts of which remain undisclosed. JPMorgan Settlement Context The January 2023 Boies complaint against JPMorgan alleged that "Highbridge, a wholly-owned subsidiary of JP Morgan, trafficked young women and girls on its own private jet from Florida to Epstein in New York as late as 2012." JPMorgan denied this, and the case settled for $290 million before the allegation could be tested at trial. JPMorgan's post-death SAR flagged approximately 4,700 Epstein-related transactions exceeding $1 billion, naming Glenn Dubin among the counterparties. ---

excerpt: Aliases: ader Category: Rothschild Group executive; CEO, Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. Source files: DOJ EFTA Email Datasets 9, 10, 11; OSINT; Beyond Existing Research
fullText: Ariane de Rothschild Aliases: ader Category: Rothschild Group executive; CEO, Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. Source files: DOJ EFTA Email Datasets 9, 10, 11; OSINT; Beyond Existing Research Aliases ader Category Rothschild Group executive; CEO, Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. "Whoops" Research: $25M Contract Mechanism CEO of the Edmond de Rothschild Group. Maintained over a dozen meetings with Epstein from 2013 to 2019. Bought nearly $1 million in auction items on Epstein's behalf and crafted custom candles etched with his favorite mathematical formula. The $25 million contract (EFTA00310331, dated October 5, 2015) between Epstein's Southern Trust Company and Edmond de Rothschild Holding was structured around "risk analysis" and "application of certain algorithms" — but the payment was triggered by the Rothschild Group's settlement with US authorities over Swiss banking violations. If the DOJ penalty stayed under $75 million, Epstein received $25 million; between $75–150 million, he got $10 million. On December 18, 2015, the bank entered a non-prosecution agreement paying $45 million to the DOJ. Three days later, Benjamin de Rothschild wired $14,999,980 to Southern Trust. Epstein had connected Ariane to Obama's former White House counsel Kathy Ruemmler, who negotiated the deal. In 2019, the bank initially stated de Rothschild had "never met Epstein" — later admitting this was false. Source files DOJ EFTA Email Datasets 9, 10, 11; OSINT; Beyond Existing Research Background CEO of Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. The email correspondent abbreviated as "ader" throughout the DOJ EFTA datasets is Ariane de Rothschild, confirmed by correspondence topics (DOJ Swiss Bank Program, Luxembourg regulator, internal Rothschild banking operations), the $25M contract signed by her, and references to "benj" (Benjamin de Rothschild, her late husband), "David" (David de Rothschild, rival branch head), and Luxembourg regulatory matters. Approximately 50 meetings between Epstein and Ariane de Rothschild documented from 2013 to 2019. CEHTTF subpoena (EFTA00154007) requested her personal information. $25 Million Contract and Payment: The October 5, 2015 $25 million contract with Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. was signed by Ariane de Rothschild and Epstein (for Southern Trust) for "risk analysis and algorithm-related services." Payment was triggered when the Rothschild Group completed a $45.2 million penalty under the DOJ's Swiss Bank Program. Wires totaling $25 million hit Epstein's accounts December 17 and 21, 2015. DOJ Crisis Management Role (2014–2015) From at least June 2014, Epstein was actively coordinating with Ariane to manage Edmond de Rothschild Group's document submissions to the DOJ under the Swiss Bank Program. On June 30, 2014, Ariane wrote: "I would hope that you guys HAVE NOT given the info today to justice. Many banks with agreement have delayed presenting until July 31" (EFTA01918634). On July 3, 2014, Epstein was alarmed when Rothschild internal figures engaged independent DOJ counsel at Steptoe & Johnson, suggesting he expected to remain the primary channel (EFTA01918688). On July 21, 2014, Ariane wrote: "I restructure the bank, you restructure my things" — explicitly framing the relationship as an exchange (EFTA01916862). In an undated email, Ariane relayed: "Yves told me that DOJ asked for more documents on various accounts" — showing Epstein received real-time intelligence on DOJ investigative demands (EFTA02479357). Financial Structuring and Wire Discussion On December 15, 2015, immediately before the $25M wires, Ariane wrote she would "prefer that all monies are transferred... before [benj] meeting." Epstein responded: "I'm wondering whether we should separate the payments from Lugano and Geneva and can we deduct the penalty as a business expense to maintain reputation or some classification" (EFTA02478207). This is direct pre-payment financial structuring advice, not mere receipt of a consulting fee. Police Raid and Bank Cleaning On June 29, 2016, Ariane messaged Epstein: "Shit is hitting the fan. Police throughout the bank — full bank search with people locked out and not allowed to get out" (EFTA02459026). Her first call during an active law enforcement raid was to Epstein, establishing him as her crisis contact. On December 3, 2017, Epstein commented that "cleaning the bank was brilliant" (EFTA02561008) — referring to account/documentation restructuring in anticipation of or response to law enforcement. Network Broker Role Ariane asked Epstein about Ehud Barak (June 29, 2013, EFTA01967168) and whether he knew Prince Andrew (October 1, 2014, EFTA02516685). On September 20, 2014, Epstein offered to negotiate with David de Rothschild on her behalf (EFTA02590201). On January 2, 2015, Ariane asked Epstein to arrange a meeting with "Leonard Fisher" (EFTA02342688). Epstein brokered introductions and served as primary confidant in internal Rothschild power conflicts. Epstein introduced Kathryn Ruemmler (former Obama White House Counsel) to Ariane as DOJ counsel for the $45.2 million non-prosecution agreement. By February 2016, Epstein was emailing Peter Thiel: "As you probably know, I represent the Rothschilds," describing a bank with "$160 billion under management" and "the world's best client list" but "prehistoric products." Inter-Branch Rivalry On June 29, 2013, Ariane expressed intent to "out-jew David" — a reference to David de Rothschild, head of the competing Rothschild & Co branch (EFTA01967168). On October 6, 2014, regarding a visit from "Jacob" (likely Jacob Rothschild): "I wonder what he plans to extort from me" (EFTA02593970). On November 18, 2015, Ariane received a letter from David and immediately contacted Epstein (EFTA02480120). On June 7, 2016, she discussed David's merger with Martin Maurel (EFTA02461805). Ongoing Strategic Advisory (2016–2017) On November 30, 2016, Epstein commented "it will be six years at least" regarding Swiss bank regulatory enforcement timelines (EFTA01060183). title: Bill Gates
excerpt: Born: October 28, 1955 Category: Microsoft founder / philanthropist Source files: All 9 source files
fullText: Bill Gates Born: October 28, 1955 Category: Microsoft founder / philanthropist Source files: All 9 source files Born October 28, 1955 Category Microsoft founder / philanthropist Source files All 9 source files The Gates-Epstein relationship, documented across at least six confirmed meetings from 2011 to 2014, operated primarily through philanthropic channels rather than direct co-investment — but the financial flows it generated were substantial and traceable. December 1–3, 2010 scheduling emails show Groff coordinating a Gates dinner at Epstein's residence. A February 2011 email from Epstein reads: "You and I are invited to Seattle to spend serious time with Bill Gates." Gates canceled his keynote at the India AI Summit on February 19, 2026, saying he was "foolish" to spend time with Epstein. Meeting-to-Grant Pipeline Gates first visited Epstein's Manhattan townhouse on January 31, 2011. The pivotal meeting occurred on May 3, 2011: Gates, Epstein, JPMorgan executive Jes Staley, former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers, and Gates advisor Boris Nikolic convened at Epstein's townhouse. Within months, Epstein was pitching a multibillion-dollar Donor-Advised Fund through the Gates Foundation — a vehicle that would have generated management fees for Epstein and tax advantages for billionaire donors. The fund's architecture was detailed enough that the Foundation's CFO sent Epstein structural drafts and the General Counsel emailed about legal frameworks. Gates himself participated, outlining "$1 billion commitment" scenarios. The fund was never created — reportedly because Melinda Gates blocked it. $2M MIT Media Lab Grant: MIT internal communications describe it as a "$2M gift from Bill Gates directed by Jeffrey Epstein." The timeline: in October 2014, Gates Ventures CEO Larry Cohen emailed Epstein about the MIT donation status ("let them know we are prepping letter, etc and wire will go 3rd of Nov"). Epstein followed up: "did mit get donation." The wire went through in November 2014. While MIT's Goodwin Procter investigation found "no evidence that Gates and Black acted to 'launder' Epstein's money," the operational reality was that Epstein functioned as the grant's architect and project manager, coordinating between Gates's office and MIT. IPI Grants ($8.5M Total) In March 2013, Gates met Epstein and IPI personnel at the home of Norwegian Nobel Committee chair Thorbjorn Jagland in Strasbourg. By October 2013, the Gates Foundation issued its first IPI grant: $2.5 million for polio eradication. Total Gates Foundation grants to IPI eventually reached approximately $8.5 million. IPI had separately received $375,000 from Epstein's foundation, and its president described Epstein as "my best friend." Flight and Blackmail Dynamic Gates flew on Epstein's private jet on March 1, 2013 (Teterboro to Palm Beach), the only documented flight. More consequential than the flight itself was what Epstein accumulated during the relationship. On July 4, 2013, Epstein emailed Boris Nikolic: "Bill risks going from richest man to biggest hypocrite, melinda a laughing stock." Two weeks later, Epstein drafted emails to himself alleging Gates had affairs and sought antibiotics for an STD. These documents — confirmed as existing in DOJ files but unverified as to truthfulness — suggest Epstein was building leverage. Boris Nikolic was named backup executor of Epstein's $578 million estate two days before Epstein's death, a connection Nikolic claimed to be unaware of. Text messages from 2017 show a Gates adviser telling Epstein: "He wants to talk to you but his wife won't let him" and "he loves you." A March 2017 email shows Epstein introducing Gates to Tom Barrack. No direct Cascade Investment-Epstein co-investments were found. The financial transmission operated through philanthropy and introductions rather than securities markets. ---

title: Autopsy Performed

fullText: Autopsy Performed Dr. Roman initially listed the manner of death as "pending" rather than suicide. Mark Epstein stated she told the family the injuries "looked too much like a homicide." Dr. Michael Baden, present at the autopsy, found three fractures: left and right thyroid cartilage and the left hyoid bone — each with hemorrhage. In 50+ years and 1,000+ jail hangings, he had "never seen three fractures" in a suicidal hanging. The ligature furrow mark was in the middle of Epstein's neck rather than beneath the jawbone as expected in hanging. Petechiae (burst capillaries) on the face, mouth, and eyes were more consistent with strangulation. Baden concluded the evidence pointed "much more to murder and strangulation than suicide." ---

fullText: Virginia Giuffre Dies by Suicide Virginia Giuffre, the most prominent Epstein accuser, died by suicide on April 25, 2025, at age 41, at her farm in Neergabby, Western Australia. Officers include Igor Fisherman, Alexander Alexandrov, Jacob Bogatin, Frank Greenwald, and Sergei Maximov. YBM becomes a primary front company for money laundering. In 1993, its tax returns showed projected gross sales of $8,573; by 1995 at the time of acquisition by Canadian company PRATECS Technologies, it claimed $32.5 million in net sales. FBI surveillance revealed the Newtown, PA facility occupied a small section of a former school building, incapable of supporting the claimed 165 employees or $20 million in sales. ---

fullText: Eurasian OC Summit at Atrium Hotel, Budapest Semion Mogilevich meets with major Eurasian OC figures at the Atrium Hotel in Budapest to discuss $4 million investment in the Black and White nightclub and prostitution operations in Budapest and Prague. Representatives at the meeting include Sergei Mikhailov and Viktor Averin (Solntsevskaya Organization), Eduard Ivankov (representing his father Vyacheslav Ivankov), and Tzigan. Mogilevich controls these operations as manager of both establishments. ---

title: Mogilevich Acquires Hungarian Arms Industry

fullText: Mogilevich Acquires Hungarian Arms Industry Through Arigon Ltd., Mogilevich obtains a 90% interest in Army Co-op (701 million Hungarian forints) with the assistance of Viktor Naishuller. Finances come from Balchug Ltd. accounts in London — Sergei Maximov, CEO of Army Co-op and YBM Magnex board member, transports $3.8 million from London to Hungary. Army Co-op then privatizes the state-run DIGEP machine factory, enabling Mogilevich to become a direct owner of the Hungarian armaments industry. In 1994, Mogilevich purchases a license to buy and sell weapons through Army Co-op and traditional Hungarian arms export companies. Maximov is reportedly murdered in Moscow in October 1993. ---

title: $18–20M Soviet Military Equipment Theft

fullText: $18–20M Soviet Military Equipment Theft Mogilevich is connected to the theft of $18–20 million of military equipment left behind by the former Soviet military's Western Group of Forces (WGF) in Germany. The theft involved surplus military equipment from a transaction between the Russian Government and an undisclosed third country. Through bribery of a high-ranking Russian military officer, the perpetrators procured state-of-the-art equipment and resold it at considerable profit. Boris Kandov, a top-level financial operative for the Ivankov and Solntsevskaya organizations in Vienna, was also involved. ---

title: Multinational Working Group Identifies Mogilevich Organization

fullText: Multinational Working Group Identifies Mogilevich Organization A multinational working group on Eurasian organized crime meets in Moscow, consisting of Russian, German, Italian, and U.S. law enforcement representatives. The group identifies five Eurasian criminal organizations with multinational operations of mutual investigative interest. The Semion Mogilevich Organization is one of these five groups, triggering the comprehensive FBI intelligence report documenting the organization's structure, operations, finances, and vulnerabilities. ---

title: Mogilevich-Solntsevskaya Art Theft Scheme Targeting Russian Museums
excerpt: Leaders of the Solntsevskaya Organization reach an agreement with Mogilevich to invest large sums in a joint venture to steal art from Russian churches and museums — including the Hermitage in St.…
fullText: Mogilevich-Solntsevskaya Art Theft Scheme Targeting Russian Museums Leaders of the Solntsevskaya Organization reach an agreement with Mogilevich to invest large sums in a joint venture to steal art from Russian churches and museums — including the Hermitage in St. Petersburg. Art objects and antiques are shipped from Moscow to Budapest for "restoration," then Mogilevich ships them to London for sale through Sotheby's auction house. Fake Faberge eggs are sent back to Moscow in place of the originals. The Solntsevskaya claims to have already shipped $3 million worth of antiques. A high-level employee of Ritual Funeral Services travels to Budapest in July 1995 with a list of stolen paintings, antiques, and Faberge eggs. The operation slows after Ivankov's arrest in June 1995. ---

title: British Police Raid Arigon Ltd. Offices

fullText: British Police Raid Arigon Ltd. Offices British police raid the offices of Arigon Ltd. in the Channel Islands, arresting Mogilevich associates Adrian Churchward (managing director, married to Mogilevich's ex-wife), Galina Grigorieva, and Peter Blake-Turner. The three are interviewed and released on bail pending further investigation. Documents are confiscated from Arigon and the residences of all three suspects. The raid reportedly shakes up the organization — Mogilevich thought the possibility of a raid was inconceivable. ---

title: Czech Police Raid Eurasian OC Summit at U Holubu Restaurant
excerpt: Czech police raid a summit meeting of Eurasian OC leaders at the U Holubu Restaurant in Prague. The leaders are meeting on the occasion of Sergei Mikhailov's birthday to discuss carving up criminal…
fullText: Czech Police Raid Eurasian OC Summit at U Holubu Restaurant Czech police raid a summit meeting of Eurasian OC leaders at the U Holubu Restaurant in Prague. The leaders are meeting on the occasion of Sergei Mikhailov's birthday to discuss carving up criminal jurisdictions and resolve a dispute between Mogilevich and the Solntsevskaya Organization over the February 1995 murder of Drozhine in Moscow. Mogilevich and his lieutenant Alexei Alexandrov are absent. Police detain participants and take photographs, fingerprints, diaries, and records. Five individuals are declared persona non grata: Mogilevich, Alexei Alexandrov, Anatoly Katrich, Viktor Averin, and Sergei Mikhailov. An unidentified Russian had delivered an anonymous letter to Budapest police alleging Mogilevich was to be assassinated at the meeting — possibly Mogilevich himself made the tip as a protective measure. In the aftermath, Mogilevich initiates counteraction using Czech intelligence informants for a disinformation campaign through the media. ---

title: Vyacheslav Ivankov Arrested by FBI

fullText: Vyacheslav Ivankov Arrested by FBI The FBI arrests Vyacheslav Ivankov, considered the most influential and powerful Eurasian criminal operating in the world. He is subsequently convicted in July 1996 on extortion charges. His arrest disrupts multiple OC operations, including the Mogilevich-Solntsevskaya art theft scheme. The dynamics of Mogilevich's operations and other Eurasian OC groups are expected to change significantly. Mogilevich had allegedly secured Ivankov's early release from a Russian prison through payoffs. ---

The subject is the sharing of interests in Ukraine. The group travels around Israel, including a visit to a shooting range. Israeli National Police (INP) obtain telephone coverage of hotel rooms, detecting calls to Russia, Hungary, and Paris. ---

This meeting leads to S&A Concrete, a Genovese-Gambino joint venture controlled by Salerno and Paul Castellano (Gambino boss), building Trump Tower and Trump Plaza. John Cody, mob-connected head of Teamsters Local 282, controls concrete deliveries to Trump Tower. Cody's girlfriend Verina Hixon is given an apartment directly below Trump's penthouse. ---

fullText: David Bogatin Buys 5 Trump Tower Condos (Seized for Laundering) David Bogatin, a key member of the Mogilevich Organization and brother of Jacob Bogatin (YBM Magnex VP), purchases five condos in Trump Tower. All five units are later seized by the government for money laundering. Bogatin is imprisoned for gasoline tax fraud — evading millions in state fuel taxes, sentenced to 8 years and $5M restitution. He jumped bail, was arrested in Austria, and the UK sought his extradition on bank fraud charges. After his extradition to the US, Sergei Mikhailov of the Solntsevskaya Organization took over Bogatin's businesses. ---

fullText: Bank of New York $10 Billion Laundering Scheme The Bank of New York $10 billion money laundering scheme is exposed — one of the largest laundering operations in history. title: Alexander Litvinenko Assassinated with Polonium-210

fullText: Alexander Litvinenko Assassinated with Polonium-210 Former Russian FSB officer Alexander Litvinenko dies in London after being poisoned with polonium-210 — a state-sponsored assassination attributed to the Russian government. Shortly before his death, Litvinenko had testified that Semion Mogilevich had a "good relationship" with Vladimir Putin from the 1990s, and had held a press conference claiming Russia had been taken over by the mob. Litvinenko's testimony is a primary source documenting the Mogilevich-Putin relationship. He is one of three known investigators of the Mogilevich network who were killed. ---

fullText: Firtash Admits Mogilevich Connection to U.S. Ambassador Ukrainian oligarch Dmytro Firtash admits to the U.S. Ambassador that he got into business with Mogilevich's permission. Firtash controls RosUkrEnergo, the exclusive Russian gas intermediary supplying Ukraine through Gazprom. title: Investigative Journalist Ján Kuciak Murdered in Slovakia

fullText: Investigative Journalist Ján Kuciak Murdered in Slovakia Slovak investigative journalist Ján Kuciak is murdered along with his fiancée. Kuciak had been probing alleged fraud and mafia-linked corruption networks involving Slovak PM Robert Fico's circle and Italian organized crime ('Ndrangheta). He reported that Fico's senior aide Mária Trošková had business links with Antonino Vadalà, tied to 'Ndrangheta schemes in Slovakia. His murder triggered mass protests and Fico's resignation. Kuciak is the third known investigator of the Mogilevich network to be killed, after Alexander Litvinenko (polonium, 2006) and FBI agent Robert Levin (died in Iran under suspicious circumstances). ---

In email sign-offs, Wolfe urged Epstein to "never let the bastards get you down." Wolfe stated he never received Epstein funding, never visited his island, and never flew on his plane. ---

fullText: Nikolic Emails Gates & Epstein About Pandemic Donor-Advised Fund Boris Nikolic writes in an email to Bill Gates and Jeffrey Epstein that donor-advised funds "might be a great path forward for some key areas such as Energy, pandemic, etc." — three years before the COVID-19 pandemic. fullText: bgC3 Document Lists "Strain Pandemic Simulation" Among Deliverables A document (Bates EFTA02657725) from bgC3, Bill Gates' private office, lists "Strain pandemic simulation" among deliverables. Fact-checkers (Tempo, Fact Crescendo) rated claims connecting this to COVID-19 planning as misleading. Gates called the claim "false" in February 2026. fullText: Boris Nikolic Named Successor Executor in Epstein's Will Boris Nikolic — Harvard-trained immunologist and former chief science/technology adviser to the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation — is named successor executor in Jeffrey Epstein's will, signed just two days before Epstein's death on August 10, 2019. title: Death of Steven Elkman — Deutsche Bank Managing Director

fullText: Death of Steven Elkman — Deutsche Bank Managing Director Steven Munro Elkman, a Managing Director at Deutsche Bank's asset and wealth management unit, died of pancreatic cancer at age 68. His New York Times obituary was published on May 11, 2015 — the exact date Epstein sent a "whoops" email to Jonathan Farkas referencing the death of "Elkman" (EFTA02501993, EFTA00627271). Elkman graduated from the Graham-Eckes School in Palm Beach, Florida (1964), placing him in Epstein's geographic orbit. The Deutsche Bank connection is critical: Epstein was a client from 2013 to 2018 with over 40 accounts. Deutsche Bank later paid $75 million to settle a class action and was fined $150 million by NY regulators. ---

title: Jean-Luc Brunel found hanged in La Santé Prison, Paris
excerpt: Jean-Luc Brunel found hanged in Paris jail cell while awaiting trial on sex trafficking charges. No CCTV footage. Investigation concluded suicide.
fullText: Jean-Luc Brunel found hanged in La Santé Prison, Paris Jean-Luc Brunel, French modeling agent who appeared on at least 25 Epstein flight logs and had 10 phone numbers in Epstein's black book, was found hanged with bedsheets in his cell at La Santé Prison at approximately 1:00 AM. He was awaiting trial on charges of rape of minors, sexual assault, sexual harassment, human trafficking, and criminal conspiracy. No CCTV cameras recorded the death — French prison cells are not monitored by video under European human rights legislation. Investigation concluded suicide in March 2023 after 14 months of detention. Virginia Giuffre had testified Brunel sent 12-year-old girls to Epstein as "birthday gifts." The parallels to Epstein's own death — hanging in custody, camera issues — were widely noted. ---

title: Peter Mandelson arrested for misconduct in public office

fullText: Peter Mandelson arrested for misconduct in public office Former UK Business Secretary Peter Mandelson arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office. While serving as Business Secretary, Mandelson allegedly leaked sensitive government information to Epstein including: early notice of a €500 billion EU bank bailout, a Downing Street document proposing £20 billion in asset sales, and details about the proposed 50% tax on bankers' bonuses. He had previously been dismissed as UK Ambassador to the US (September 2025), resigned from the Labour Party (February 2026), and resigned from the House of Lords. Gordon Brown called his actions a "betrayal of his country." Mandelson described Epstein as his "best pal" in the 2003 birthday book. Bank documents show three payments totaling $75,000 to accounts linked to Mandelson. ---

title: Nadia Marcinkova (Marcinko) goes missing

fullText: Nadia Marcinkova (Marcinko) goes missing Nadia Marcinkova — born 1986 in Košice, Slovakia, described by Epstein as his "Yugoslavian sex slave," allegedly "purchased" from her family around age 13–15 — disappeared in early January 2024 when the first major Epstein court documents were unsealed. She had pleaded the Fifth Amendment 42 times in a 2010 deposition (including on questions about Prince Andrew and Bill Clinton), visited Epstein 67–70 times during his 2008–2009 incarceration, and received blanket federal immunity under the 2008 NPA. She later obtained a pilot's license and founded aviation company Aviloop. Her current whereabouts remain unknown. ---

fullText: Mary Kennedy found dead — Epstein responds "whoops" Mary Richardson Kennedy, estranged wife of RFK Jr., was found dead at her Bedford, New York home at age 52 — ruled suicide by asphyxiation due to hanging in a barn on the property. The Epstein-Kennedy overlap is documented: RFK Jr. flew on Epstein's jet at least twice, and Ghislaine Maxwell described a "very longstanding" friendship with Mary Kennedy, attending her 2012 funeral. ---

fullText: Epstein forwards DIA email to defense attorney: "defense intelligence? classified" Epstein forwarded an email from Huffman@ucia.gov (Mike Huffman, faculty at the DIA's Joint Military Attaché School) to defense attorney Martin Weinberg, writing: "defense intieligence? classifed. i think sent to me in error whoops?" The email reinforces the contested intelligence theory and Epstein's possession of classified material. ---

title: EFTA Release Framework & Document Architecture
excerpt: The House voted 427–1 (Rep. Clay Higgins sole dissent) on November 18, 2025; the Senate passed unanimously the same day. Trump signed it into law November 19, without reporters present, after…
fullText: EFTA Release Framework & Document Architecture The House voted 427–1 (Rep. Clay Higgins sole dissent) on November 18, 2025; the Senate passed unanimously the same day. Trump signed it into law November 19, without reporters present, after reporting indicated he personally lobbied individual GOP members to oppose the bill but was outmaneuvered by bipartisan momentum. The Act required DOJ to release all files within 30 days. The DOJ ultimately released approximately 3.5 million pages, 2,000 videos, and 180,000 images across multiple batches (December 19, 2025 through January 30, 2026). The DOJ gathered 6 million qualifying pages before filtering — approximately half remain unreleased. Dataset Breakdown Note on Dataset 9: The DOJ pagination operates as an "infinite loop" — pages beyond approximately 13,000 contain no new documents. Community researchers flagged the dataset as incomplete at source. Repository Structure (Four Pillars) Pillar I: DOJ Disclosures — 3.5M pages across 12 datasets Pillar II: Court Records — specific case filings (Doe v. Indyke, Maxwell trial, etc.) Pillar III: House Oversight — 8,624 committee-released documents Pillar IV: FBI Vault/FOIA — pre-existing, heavily redacted releases Key Individual Mention Frequencies Lesley Groff: 157,613 (Epstein's personal assistant — second-most mentioned person after Epstein) Richard Kahn: 52,781 (accountant/estate manager) Trump/Melania/Mar-a-Lago: 38,000+ references across 5,300+ files (NYT analysis) Darren Indyke: 17,783 (Epstein's lawyer/will executor) Ghislaine Maxwell: 13,163 Les Wexner: 4,000+ Jean-Luc Brunel: 4,727 Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem: 4,700+ Miroslav Lajčák ("Miro"): 788 Redaction Policy & Anomalies The DOJ applied blanket visual redactions — every female depicted was treated as a potential victim — except Maxwell. Males were unredacted unless linked to a protected female. Critics note this policy simultaneously exposed at least 31 child victim identities (failure to redact) and may have shielded perpetrators. Faulty redaction discovery: Community researchers found that blacked-out text in some PDFs could be recovered by copy-pasting. Using this method, researchers recovered trust beneficiary names (EFTA01296151: Maxwell; EFTA01297516: both Brunel and Maxwell) and other content including an unverified FBI tip about Trump allegedly witnessing the killing of an infant born to a trafficking victim (explicitly labeled by DOJ as an "untrue and sensationalist claim submitted right before the 2020 election"). Removed/missing documents: EFTA00000468 — Photo of Trump, Epstein, Maxwell (removed December 20, 2025, restored after public outcry) EFTA01660679 — DOJ-compiled list of tips (removed) Three large video files removed: EFTA00276494.ts (4.3 GB), EFTA01244748.wmv, EFTA01244749.wmv Community-identified never-uploaded EFTA numbers: EFTA00709804–00709807, EFTA00770595, EFTA00774768, EFTA00823190–00823192, and others ~16 files disappeared from DOJ site after initial December 19, 2025 posting; CBS News identified the gap by comparing day-one and day-two releases DOJ O'Keefe recording (September 4, 2025): James O'Keefe published a secret recording of DOJ acting Deputy Chief Joseph Schnitt, who stated: "They'll redact every Republican or conservative person in those files, leave all the liberal, Democratic people." Schnitt also said Maxwell's minimum-security prison transfer was "against BOP policy" and that AG Bondi "wants whatever Trump wants." DOJ said Schnitt had "no role in the Department's internal review." Democracy Defenders Fund filed an OIG complaint and discovered DOJ "quietly altered previously released documents" — comparison on January 15, 2026 identified modified documents with additional redactions added post-publication. ---

title: The Trafficking Operation

fullText: The Trafficking Operation The files document a structured recruitment network: - Victims were paid $200 per girl they brought to Epstein; recruiter Haley Robson was told by Epstein "the younger the better" when she brought a 23-year-old - Epstein told one victim he "purchased" Nadia Marcinkova at age 15 from her family in Yugoslavia to be his "sex slave" - Ghislaine Maxwell ran recruitment alongside Epstein, with Sarah Kel ### MC2 Modeling Agency (Jean-Luc Brunel) Jean-Luc Brunel founded MC2 with up to $1 million in Epstein funding (name reportedly referenced E=MC² with "E" for Epstein). A former MC2 bookkeeper told the FBI in 2010 that Brunel flew in teenage models from around the world, housed them in Epstein's Upper East Side apartments, and "loaned them out to wealthy clients for up to $100,000 a night." Brunel was in secret cooperation negotiations with federal prosecutors in 2016. His lawyer said Brunel had "recruited girls for Epstein and possessed incriminating photographs." A May 2016 email shows Epstein learned of the planned cooperation and alerted Kathy Ruemmler, claiming someone demanded "$3 million so that Jean Luc would not go in." Brunel went silent and was found hanged in a Paris prison on February 19, 2022. Scale of Victimization The DOJ files documented: 32-to-60-count draft federal indictment naming 19 victims (Jane Doe #1 through #19), youngest described as 14; approximately 11 attended the same Palm Beach County school Palm Beach Police identified 27 girls and women aged 14–23 who visited Epstein's home for "massage services"; FBI grand jury testimony confirmed "more than a majority would have been under the age of 18" December 2019 86-page SDNY co-conspirators prosecution memo contained statements from 24 women abused as minors and 14 abused as adults, evaluated for charges against Maxwell, Groff, and others Visa Applications & International Trafficking Dataset 8 documents show Epstein served as point of contact for non-immigrant visa applicants from Poland, Belarus, Ukraine, Russia, China, Croatia, and Slovakia (2004–2005). American Express records (exclusively reported by CBS) revealed hundreds of Amex Black Card travel bookings arranging international flights for women and girls from Russia, Poland, Belarus, Latvia, and Ukraine between 2012 and 2019 — well after his conviction. A wire transfer of 330 gallons of sulfuric acid (six 55-gallon drums) was made December 6, 2018 — the same day SDNY reportedly opened its new federal investigation. DOJ files also contain anonymous allegations of bodies buried at Zorro Ranch (unverified). Virginia Giuffre The most extensively documented victim. Recruited by Maxwell at age 16 at Mar-a-Lago. She described being trafficked to Prince Andrew (three occasions, including documented flight logs and the authenticated photo developed March 13, 2001 at a Florida Walgreens), Jean-Luc Brunel, Glenn Dubin ("Ghislaine told me to go to Glenn Dubin and give him a massage, which means sex"), Marvin Minsky, Bill Richardson, and others. Giuffre died by suicide on April 25, 2025, at age 41 at her farm in Western Australia. She was 16 when recruited from Mar-a-Lago. Her posthumous memoir "Nobody's Girl" (October 21, 2025) described meeting Trump at Mar-a-Lago ("Trump couldn't have been friendlier"), offering to help her find babysitting jobs; the memoir contains no allegations of wrongdoing by Trump. Regarding Trump, in a 2016 deposition (Giuffre v. Maxwell): "Have you ever been in Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein's presence with one another?" — "No." "Did you ever see Donald Trump at Jeffrey's home?" — "Not that I can remember." "Donald Trump never flirted with me." "I don't think Donald Trump participated in anything… I never saw or witnessed Donald Trump participate in those acts." — This remains the strongest exculpatory evidence regarding Trump. Her death removed the possibility of further testimony. Her family expressed shock at Trump's July 2025 statement that Epstein "stole" Giuffre from his spa; they said "she wasn't stolen, she was preyed upon at his property." Mogilevich Organization Context The FBI's 1996 Mogilevich intelligence report documents an extensive prostitution and human trafficking operation spanning Central Europe. Mogilevich runs prostitution operations out of the Black and White Nightclubs in Prague and Budapest — documented by foreign law enforcement as the "centerpiece of his operations in Europe." Russian women are recruited in Kiev and Moscow, provided cover jobs by Alexei Alexandrov, and placed in the market. Bodyguards are provided by Mogilevich and underboss Vitaly Savalovsky. The operation intersects with broader trafficking patterns documented in the Epstein files, sharing characteristics of cross-border recruitment, placement in entertainment venues, and protection by organized crime structures. ---

title: Trump–Epstein Connections

fullText: Trump–Epstein Connections - An FBI witness reported they "saw Epstein and Trump together a lot including at the movies. Trump was always trying to impress Epstein." The same witness said they overheard Trump claiming "he went to Israel and a sheik gave his virgin daughter to him." (EFTA00095502) - 1992 "calendar girl competition" at Mar-a-Lago organized ### Flight Records A January 2020 email from an SDNY prosecutor (released in December 2025 DOJ batch): "the flight records we reflect that Donald Trump traveled on Epstein's private jet many more times than we previously had reported or that we were aware of." Document EFTA00016732. Federal records document at least 8 flights between 1993 and 1996: May 15, 1994: Palm Beach → Teterboro via D.C. — with Marla Maples and infant Tiffany Trump August 13, 1995: Palm Beach → Teterboro — with Eric Trump and Maxwell January 5, 1997: Palm Beach → Newark One 1993 flight: only Trump and Epstein listed as passengers Maxwell was present on at least four flights All documented flights were domestic routes — no evidence places Trump on flights to Little St. James. Pilot Larry Visoski confirmed Trump as a passenger during Maxwell trial testimony in December 2021. Trump's 2024 statement: "I was never on Epstein's Plane." The "Knew About the Girls" Emails Three pivotal emails released by House Oversight Committee Democrats (November 12, 2025): Email 1 (April 2, 2011, Epstein to Maxwell): "I want you to realize that that dog that hasn't barked is trump.. [VICTIM] spent hours at my house with him,, he has never once been mentioned. police chief. etc. im 75% there." Maxwell replied: "I have been thinking about that." House Republicans identified the redacted victim as Virginia Giuffre — who did not accuse Trump in her sworn testimony. Email 2 (January 31, 2019, Epstein to Michael Wolff): "[Victim] mara lago. [identifier]. Trump said he asked me to resign, never a member ever. Of course he knew about the girls as he asked ghislaine to stop." This is the most widely covered email in the releases. FactCheck.org noted it "could be interpreted multiple ways" and doesn't specify if Epstein was referring to underage girls or definitively show Trump had knowledge of criminal activity. Email 3 (December 2015, Wolff to Epstein): Wolff advised Epstein on how to exploit Trump's potential denials for "valuable PR and political currency" — "if he says he hasn't been on the plane or to the house, then that gives you a valuable PR and political currency. You can hang him in a way that potentially generates a positive benefit for you." CNN planned to ask Trump about Epstein at a debate but did not ask the question. Additional emails from the same November 2025 release (House Republicans, 23,000 pages): A 2018 Epstein email stating "I am the one able to take him down" (referring to Trump); a 2017 email to Larry Summers: "I have met some very bad people, none as bad as trump. Not one decent cell in his body." Fifth Amendment Exchange The deposition occurred March 17, 2010, in Edwards v. Epstein. When asked: "Have you ever socialized with Donald Trump in the presence of females under the age of 18?" Epstein responded: "Though I'd like to answer that question, at least today I'm going to have to assert my Fifth, Sixth, and 14th Amendment rights, sir." Epstein invoked the Fifth over 1,000 times across his depositions, including about Clinton, Prince Andrew, and Maxwell. A 34-second clip went viral in July 2025. Court record quote: "...conceivably it would be the same response in Mr. Trump's situation, as the proprietor of Mar-a-Lago, there could be numerous occasions where Mr. Epstein may have been an invited guest and Mr. Trump's own daughters, who may have been under the age of 18 at the time, were also invited guests..." (EFTA00800982) The Mar-a-Lago Ban — Four Competing Narratives Four distinct accounts exist for why Epstein was removed from Mar-a-Lago: 1. Real estate dispute over Maison de l'Amitié in 2004 2. 18-year-old beautician complaint in 2003 3. Harassment of a club member's teenage daughter at the pool circa October 2007 (when Mar-a-Lago records show Epstein's account "closed") 4. Trump's July 2025 claim that Epstein "stole" spa employees Epstein's own email contradicts Trump's narrative: "Trump said he asked me to resign, never a member ever." A 2009 email summarizing a call with Brad Edwards quoted Trump saying Epstein "was not a member of his club at Mar-a-Lago, but he was a guest, and he had never been asked to leave." Brad Edwards (victims' attorney) stated Trump was "the only person" among Epstein's associates who cooperated voluntarily: "the only person who, in my experience, worked with us, was Donald Trump" — calling Trump "very helpful." July 2006: Per FBI interview with Palm Beach Police Chief Michael Reiter (October 2019), Trump called Reiter saying: "Thank goodness you're stopping him, everyone has known he's been doing this." Trump also told Reiter Maxwell was Epstein's "operative" and "evil." This is significant because in July 2019, Trump told reporters he "had no idea" about Epstein's conduct. Accusers & Allegations Involving Trump The "Jane"/Interlochen victim: Court documents describe a girl taken to Mar-a-Lago in 1994 when she was approximately 14. Recruited by Epstein at Interlochen Center for the Arts. In her FBI 302, she stated Epstein introduced her to Trump, and Epstein "elbowed Trump playfully, asking him, 'This is a good one, right?'" Trump "smiled and nodded." She testified at Maxwell's 2021 trial (as "Jane") but did not describe inappropriate behavior by Trump. Her FBI interview was temporarily removed from the DOJ database; her mother's interview — recalling hearing "a prince and DONALD TRUMP visited EPSTEIN's house" — remains offline. ~1983 accuser: An FBI memo from the January 30, 2026 release detailed a woman's claim that around 1983, when she was approximately 13, Epstein introduced her to Trump, "who subsequently forced her head down to his exposed penis which she subsequently bit. In response, Trump punched her in the head and kicked her out." The FBI interviewed this accuser four times. Only the first interview (July 24, 2019) is in the public database, and it does not mention Trump. Of 15 documents listed in Maxwell case discovery for this accuser, only 7 are publicly available. 53 pages of interview documents appear to be missing (NPR, February 24, 2026). Her attorney said she "was concerned about implicating additional individuals, and specifically any that were well known, due to fear of retaliation." Maxwell "presented" a victim to Trump: A 2021 FBI memo described an Epstein victim who told investigators Maxwell once "presented" her to Trump at a party in New York, with Maxwell saying: "Oh I think he likes you. Aren't you lucky." The FBI memo noted it was "set up very much like how Maxwell introduced her to Epstein." The woman told investigators "nothing happened" between her and Trump. Stacey Williams (October 2024): Former Sports Illustrated swimsuit model alleged Trump groped her when Epstein brought her to Trump Tower in the early 1990s. "I felt so humiliated and so sick to my stomach." She said Epstein talked about Trump "every time we spoke" and that Trump sent her a handwritten postcard: "Stacey — Your home away from home. Love Donald." The "Katie Johnson" / Jane Doe Lawsuit: Three filings in 2016; withdrawn November 4, 2016 (six days before the election) after plaintiff received threats. The suit alleged rape by Trump and Epstein in 1994 when plaintiff was 13. Attorney Cheney Mason told journalist Tara Palmeri in 2025 he "still insists she told the truth." Michael Cohen confirmed Trump dispatched him to "take care of it." Credibility note: promotion of the case traced to "Norm Lubow," former Jerry Springer producer; Julie K. Brown said "the woman just wouldn't talk." FBI complaint form in January 2026 release is consistent with the lawsuit. NPR investigation (February 24, 2026): Reporter Stephen Fowler found more than 50 pages of FBI interviews and notes from conversations with women who accused Trump of sexual abuse as minors have been withheld from the public database despite the EFTA mandate. Identified through systematic serial number analysis. Trump Administration Officials Named in Files Tom Barrack (U.S. Ambassador to Turkey): 100+ text/email exchanges with Epstein from at least 2009 through 2018. Epstein regarded Barrack as a "potential conduit for passing information to Mr. Trump," with Barrack replying "on the bosses list" in one exchange. Epstein forwarded Barrack the "Katie Johnson" lawsuit email in April 2016. On August 29, 2016, a lunch was listed with Barrack, Ehud Barak, and Russian UN Ambassador Vitaly Churkin; the day after, Epstein purchased approximately $1 million in Colony Capital stock (Barrack's company). After Trump's election, a senior Saudi official texted Epstein asking about protocol for King Salman to call Trump; Epstein replied: "TOM barrack is your point person." Howard Lutnick (Commerce Secretary): Co-signed business documents with Epstein for a company called Adfin in December 2012, contradicting his public claim of cutting ties in 2005. Confirmed December 23, 2012 island lunch. Epstein's assistant forwarded Lutnick documents about casino legislation in the U.S. Virgin Islands. Faces bipartisan calls for resignation. Steve Feinberg (Deputy Defense Secretary): Named/correspondence in files. John Phelan (Navy Secretary): Named/correspondence in files. Alexander Acosta (Labor Secretary): Led the controversial 2008 non-prosecution agreement (see Section 14). Steve Bannon (Chief Strategist): See Section 5. Trump's Public Statements Timeline July 2006: Called Palm Beach Police Chief Reiter: "Thank goodness you're stopping him, everyone has known he's been doing this." 2009: Cooperation with Brad Edwards; described Epstein as "not a member" but noted "he had never been asked to leave." July 2019 (post-arrest): "I had no idea" about Epstein's conduct; called him "not a friend" and said he "had a falling out with him a long time ago." July 12, 2025: Defended AG Bondi and called Epstein "somebody that nobody cares about." July 16, 2025: Called the files "a big hoax." July 28, 2025 (Scotland): Shifted explanation for banning Epstein: "He stole people that worked for me." November 14, 2025: Asked about the "knew about the girls" email: "I know nothing about that." Truth Social posts: Called the case "the Jeffrey Epstein Hoax" and wrote "My PAST supporters have bought into this 'bull—t,' hook, line, and sinker. I don't want their support anymore!" October 2025 (Oval Office): On a possible Maxwell pardon: "I haven't heard the name in so long... I'd have to take a look at it." Trump's Legal Actions July 18, 2025: Filed $10 billion defamation lawsuit against Dow Jones, News Corp, Rupert Murdoch, and two WSJ reporters over the birthday letter story (see Section 16). WSJ filed to dismiss in September 2025, arguing the article is true — Epstein's estate produced the birthday book. The House Oversight Committee released the actual letter in September 2025, confirming WSJ's reporting. Case pending as of late 2025. September 15, 2025: Filed $15 billion lawsuit against the New York Times, Penguin Random House, and four reporters. Judge Merryday dismissed the initial complaint as "tediously and burdensomely" improper September 19; Trump refiled within 28 days. Trump's Black Book Entry Epstein's black book listed Trump with 16 phone numbers — one of the highest counts — including emergency, car, security guard, and houseman numbers. His was among five names circled or highlighted. Also listed: Ivana Trump, Ivanka Trump, Robert Trump, Blaine Trump, and Melania (listed as "Milania"). Mogilevich Organization Context The Ryan Middleton connections map documents how the Mogilevich Organization's presence in Trump Tower predates and parallels Epstein's social connections to Trump. David Bogatin (key Mogilevich member) purchased 5 Trump Tower condos — all seized for money laundering. Vyacheslav Ivankov (Mogilevich lieutenant, "most influential Eurasian criminal") operated from Trump Tower with Trump Organization phone numbers. Felix Sater, son of Mogilevich syndicate boss Mikhail Sheferovsky, served as "Senior Adviser to Donald Trump" and co-developed Trump SoHo through Bayrock Group. Attorney Roy Cohn bridged Trump to the Five Families (Gambino, Genovese), while Manafort's connection to Firtash (who admitted Mogilevich association to the U.S. Ambassador) created another channel between the Trump orbit and Eurasian organized crime. ---

fullText: Financial Crimes & Money Laundering Rep. The Butterfly Trust account (EFTA00029805) shows the JPMorgan brokerage structure. Attorney Darren Indyke made 97 cash withdrawals of exactly $7,500 each — the bank's limit for third-party withdrawals — occurring 2–3 times monthly from 2013 to 2017 (textbook structuring). In one instance, Indyke asked about the $10,000 reporting threshold and, upon learning it would trigger a report, split the withdrawal over two days. The Butterfly Trust (established 2013/2014) named co-conspirators 1–3 as beneficiaries — a compliance officer flagged this and was overruled. It funded 120+ wire transfers totaling $2.65M to beneficiaries including women with Eastern European surnames for "hotel expenses, tuition, and rent."
